gpqa_diamond.low.note: Run predates per-record prompt_sha256. Prompts and golds rebuilt from the harness at the run-start commit are byte-identical to HEAD, so HEAD re-derives exactly what was sent. This is a SET-level proof, weaker than a per-record hash, and is reported as such.
